prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Production RGBA cutout atlas 1536x1024 for a detailed paper pop-up miniature, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, generous transparent gutters. Twelve isolated components, no text, no grid lines.
Theme: Pokémon Emerald Team Aqua's secret submarine dock inside an indigo coastal cave. Cobalt blue and off-white striped machinery, teal water, tiny warm amber lamps, cyan screen graphics. Do not draw a whole scene.
STYLE MOST IMPORTANT: hand-cut illustrated paper theatre, thin layered flat silhouettes, fine cream cut edges, narrow shadows ONLY between paper layers, subtle paper grain, rich small hand-drawn details (panel seams, tiny screws, colored buttons). NOT photorealistic, not chunky block models, not low poly 3D, not blurry painting. Front view, shallow folded-paper top surfaces only.
Row 1 left to right:
1. Left irregular cave wall made of thin overlapping navy paper rock ribbons, open to right, no complete arch, no floor.
2. Different right irregular cave wall made of thin overlapping cobalt paper rock ribbons, open to left, no complete arch, no floor.
3. Narrow low backdrop of dark navy paper mineral silhouettes, staggered narrow peaks, no filled rectangular backdrop.
4. Three SEPARATE thin hanging cable-and-lamp cutouts, each curved dark paper cable ending in a little warm amber paper lantern. Visible gaps between all three, no top connecting strip.
Row 2 left to right:
5. Control console silhouette: tall off-white/cobalt paper panels, two cyan screens with thin diagram traces, little colorful buttons, one narrow side pipe. No rocks or floor.
6. Teleporter platform silhouette: low slate/off-white striped deck, cyan elliptical ring on top, two low thin paper railing posts; no rocks.
7. Small industrial sliding door silhouette with blue/white striped frame and two small amber lamps, dark seam in middle, no cave behind it.
8. Submarine silhouette in SIDE VIEW, folded blue paper hull, simple rounded bow and pointed stern, paper porthole rings, small tower, no water, no long tall periscope.
Row 3 left to right:
9. Low wide wave ribbon: four overlapping scalloped strips of teal, turquoise and navy paper with tiny cream edge glints, no rocks or background.
10. Compact slate outcrop: five individual flat indigo paper rock facets overlapping, fine pale cut edges, small cracks.
11. Compact pair of blue paper supply crates and a bent pipe with a small valve wheel, no ground.
12. A single isolated slender bent navy paper periscope with a small pale lens and, well separated beside it, two little ivory/aqua paper bubble rings.
All components fit inside their own cell. True alpha transparency in empty areas. No floor or cast ground shadows, no backdrop haze, no characters, no ball, no text, no logos or watermark.
